name: Femboy & Futa Maidmare
source: A psychological horror visual novel set in a neon-lit motel. Work the night shift, build relationships with the unusual staff, make choices, and investigate increasingly strange events as the line between memory and reality begins to blur.
translation: 一款以霓虹闪烁的汽车旅馆为背景的心理恐怖视觉小说。值守夜班，与性格古怪的员工们建立关系，做出你的抉择，并在记忆与现实的界限日渐模糊之际，深入调查接踵而至的离奇事件。
